source_text: Si quis dicat ex semine viri genitum esse Christum de Virgine, sicut omnes alii nascuntur homines; et non confitetur ipsum ex Spiritu sancto, et ex sancta Maria virgine incarnatum, et factum hominem ex semine David, sicut scriptum est; anathema sit. Quomodo dici potest ex semine viri genitus Christus ex Virgine; cum sanctum Evangelium, et ipse Angelus testentur, Mariam Virginem dixisse: Quomodo fiet mihi istud; quoniam virum non cognosco? Ideo et qui nuntiavit Mariae, dixit: Spiritus sanctus superveniet in te, et virtus Altissimi obumbrabit tibi. Quamobrem et quod natum est ex te sanctum, vocabitur filius Altissimi. Et Iosepho dicit: Ne timeas accipere Mariam coniugem tuam. Quod enim in ea natum est, ex Spiritu sancto est: pariet vero filium, et vocabunt nomen eius Iesum. Ipse enim salvum faciet populum suum a peccatis eorum.
thought_title: The virgin birth and conception by the Holy Spirit
orientation: Gregory anathematizes anyone who claims Christ was begotten from a man's seed like ordinary humans, affirming instead the Gospel accounts of conception by the Holy Spirit and the angelic announcements to Mary and Joseph.
pass_a_gloss: If anyone shall say from seed of man born to be Christ from Virgin, just as all others are born men; and not confesses him from Spirit holy, and from holy Mary virgin incarnate, and made man from seed of David, as [it is] written; anathema let him be. How can [it] be said from seed of man born Christ from Virgin; since holy Gospel, and himself Angel testify, Mary Virgin [to have] said: How shall be made to me this; since man not I know? Therefore also he who announced to Mary, said: Spirit holy shall come upon in you, and power of Highest shall overshadow you. Wherefore also that which born is from you holy, shall be called son of Highest. And to Joseph he says: Not fear to take Mary wife your. What indeed in her born is, from Spirit holy is: she shall bear indeed son, and they shall call name his Jesus. He indeed shall save people his from sins their.

lemmas.gloss: know / have sexual knowledge of (indicative present)

choices.english: from the seed of a man
choices.why: Literal rendering of the biological claim being rejected; 'seed of a man' preserves the source's wording against 'human seed' or 'man's seed'.
Glossary-locked formula of condemnation; 'anathema' is the technical term.

choices.english: How will this be to me
choices.why: Literal translation of Mary's question; 'to me' preserves the dative mihi rather than 'for me'.
rejected: How will this happen to me
How shall this be done unto me

choices.english: I do not know a man
choices.why: Preserves the euphemistic idiom for sexual knowledge; 'know a man' is the standard literal sense.
rejected: I have not known a man
I am not acquainted with a man

choices.english: the power of the Most High will overshadow you
choices.why: Literal rendering of Luke's phrasing; 'overshadow' is the proper verb for obumbrabit.
rejected: the power of the Most High will cover you
the Most High's power will shade you

pass_b_english: If anyone says that Christ was born from the seed of a man from the Virgin, just as all other human beings are born, and does not confess that he was incarnate by the Holy Spirit and from the holy Virgin Mary, and made a human being from the seed of David, as it is written, let him be anathema. How can Christ be said to have been born from the seed of a man from the Virgin, when the holy Gospel and the Angel himself testify that the Virgin Mary said: "How will this be to me, since I do not know a man?" That is why the one who announced the news to Mary said: "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of the Most High." And he says to Joseph: "Do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife. For what is born in her is from the Holy Spirit. She will bear a son, and they will call his name Jesus. For he will save his people from their sins."
